subject.title: fix(cli): report a cold-start session as "agent starting", not "needs reconnect"

question: Should the prompt banner’s user-visible cold-start token change from `needs reconnect` to `starting`, accepting the compatibility impact for downstream consumers of human-readable stderr?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and well-proven, but repository policy makes the permanent output token a maintainer-owned product decision.

options.title: Adopt `starting`
options.body: Merge the focused change because it accurately describes the normal on-demand owner path and removes a false failure signal.

options.title: Select another neutral token
options.body: Choose a maintainer-preferred transitional status while preserving the distinction between normal lazy startup and explicit startup failure.

options.title: Preserve current wording
options.body: Keep the existing token for compatibility and document that the stderr banner is advisory rather than a connection failure.

recommendation.title: Adopt `starting`
recommendation.body: Merge the focused change because it accurately describes the normal on-demand owner path and removes a false failure signal.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the best available adjacent ownership signal for the ACPX session-lifecycle and output-contract decision.
